arcSummary: Sable knows seventeen ways to kill something before it knows she's there. The number used to be even. The eighteenth saw her, and she didn't.

stages.title: Seventeen
stages.summary: She names the count for the first time: where each way came from, and why the list stopped growing.

stages.title: The One That Saw Her
stages.summary: Old territorial sign on the route. Hers, in a sense: the beast that looked her in the eye and made her miss on purpose.

stages.title: Warden, Not Poacher
stages.summary: Seventeen ways to kill unseen are also seventeen ways to see. She has a proposal for the campus grounds.
